system: Yakıt & Hava Ölçümü (MAF, MAP, O2, ECT Sensörleri)
symptoms: MIL (Malfunction Indicator Lamp) illumination will always occur
Vehicle may be hard to start
May blow a lot of black smoke and run extremely rich
Engine may want to die or backfire in tailpipe
Engine may run lean and increased Nox emissions may be apparent (Requires gas analyzer)

questions.text: Şu olası nedeni kontrol ettiniz mi: Wiring or connector damaged at sensor?
questions.why: P0115 için en sık bildirilen kök neden

questions.text: Sensör/aktüatör kablo tesisatında kopuk veya kısa devre var mı (Open  or short in reference or signal circuit)?
